faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Latitude 5500, 5501, 5510, 5511 and P80F, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Does this come with the palmrest cover?
faqs.answer: No — this is the keyboard only, without the surrounding palmrest cover.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes the backlight cable, matching the original.
